author: blu
body: The Sensors effect is the right to read the machine's inertial and environmental sensors. It is a bare marker here, the way Microphone and Location are: accelerometer, gyroscope, barometer and light-level are not declared in this chapter.

author: blu
body: This machine has no accelerometer, no gyroscope, no barometer and no ambient light sensor. A chapter that wants the operations anyway cites Foreword chapter SensorsStub and gets constants; a chapter that does not gets CDX3002 on the name.
